id.description: This value uniquely identifies the record within its declared entity and version scope.

blueprint_id.description: This identifier refers to the source blueprint version.

taxonomy_id.description: This field references a registered category at the declared taxonomy version.

canonical_utterance_id.description: This identifier locates the canonical utterance for the opportunity.

start_cp.description: This offset is the included start of a Unicode codepoint span.

end_cp.description: This offset is the excluded end of a Unicode codepoint span.

exact_text.description: This text must equal the original substring at the specified codepoint offsets.

eligible_span.description: This span locates the canonical material available for the planned mutation.

realization_state.description: This field records whether the planned opportunity actually produced its required target.

realized_unit_id.description: This identifier links the opportunity to the actual resulting detection unit.

evidence_ids.description: These IDs identify actual supporting records within the permitted subject and version scope.
